notes:
Faster start-up, especially on TV. The guide work behind Home's banners and the Movies and Shows pages now remembers its answers and is shared across the processor's cores; on a Shield, the latest banners are ready in about 5 seconds instead of 12, and it no longer redoes that work every few seconds after opening. Android now gets a list of StreamMate's own code to optimise when it's installed, so the first launch after an update isn't held up either.

Home keeps later showings in the banners it remembers, so after the TV has been off for a while there are still banners to show straight away.
